author: claude-fable-5-1 as reference translator, 2026-10-13
notes: Gold routing for user messages against the clean tidepool graph. `path` is the funnel's expected walk: space, kind, node ids (empty when the message creates something new). `ops` are the expected edits in canonical graph terms; `question` is expected when the message is ambiguous. Difficulty: easy = one node named outright; medium = node implied by content; hard = cross-cutting, several nodes, or needs a question.

cases.message: The GPS rule should be 10 metres, not 20.

fields.title: Every observation carries a GPS fix within 10 m of its site

cases.note: The 40 m test still passes at 10 m; listing it under `also` is a bonus, not required.

cases.message: Rename the species picker to 'Species chooser'.
Drop the low-tide reminders feature; the pilot showed it doesn't work.
cases.note: Removing the feature orphans its flow and agent; a good translator proposes removing or re-homing them, or asks. Either is accepted if the feature removal is present.

cases.message: We also need to support school groups doing shore surveys with a teacher.
cases.note: Linking to the existing log-a-transect use case is a bonus.

cases.message: Verification should happen within 3 days, not 7.

fields.title: Two-thirds of records verified within 3 days

cases.message: The August acceptance number was actually 71%, not 64%.
Add a test that a survey started two hours before low tide is rejected.

ops.title: Survey started 120 minutes before low tide is rejected

cases.note: The new test must verify the 90-minute rule.

cases.message: The reconnect GPS test is failing in build 89; make the photo queue task cover resuming after an app restart too.

fields.description: Resume interrupted uploads, including after the app is restarted, so the reconnect GPS test passes.

cases.note: Two tasks exist under the epic; the message names resuming, so the resume task is the target. Choosing the queue task instead is wrong.

cases.message: Volunteers should be able to log a survey without ever taking a photo.

fields.title: Volunteers may skip photos; a quadrat can be logged without one

cases.note: The assumption is contradicted; updating or removing it is accepted. A translator that only edits the feature misses the assumption.

cases.message: Make it offline.

gold.question: Tidepool is already offline-first for transect logging and sync; which part should change, e.g. verification or photo ID suggestions working offline?

cases.note: The system is already offline-first; the right move is a question naming what is already offline.

cases.message: The species suggestion agent should also use the photo's GPS fix to narrow candidates.

fields.description: Suggest species from a field photo, narrowing candidates by the photo's GPS fix and site.

cases.note: Either the ai-function or the agent node is an acceptable primary target; the link to observation (which carries the GPS fix) is a bonus.

cases.message: Add a metric for how many photos each survey has.
cases.note: No outcome names photos, so no `monitors` link is required.

cases.message: The verification queue is too slow for biologists; blurry photos should be flagged before they reach the queue.

ops.title: A blurry field photo is flagged before verification

cases.note: Accept a new rule governing field photo, or a new flow/feature step on the field capture side; editing only the verification queue screen is wrong.

cases.message: Tide tables are only accurate to 30 minutes at the northern sites.

fields.title: Public tide tables are accurate to 30 minutes per site

cases.message: We're switching the taxonomy source from iNaturalist to WoRMS.
cases.note: Replace-in-place or remove-and-add with relinked `uses` edges are both accepted.

cases.message: Who is this for?
cases.note: An informational question: route to the audiences and answer; no edit.

cases.message: Percent cover should be estimated in 10% steps, 5% is too fine for volunteers.

fields.description: Share of a quadrat's area occupied by one species, estimated in 10% steps.

cases.message: A record can get a second verdict if the first verifier flags it as uncertain.

fields.title: A record has exactly one final verdict unless the first verdict is marked uncertain

cases.note: The existing test contradicts the new rule; flagging it is a bonus.

cases.message: Move the site map into the verification service, the biologists use it more than volunteers do.
The reminder cohort data was wrong; reminders did lift returns by 20%.

fields.title: Reminder cohort returned 20% more often than control

cases.note: Flipping refutes to supports is required; a translator that only edits the title misses the point.

cases.message: Can we make it faster?

gold.question: Faster where: syncing records after reconnect, photo uploads, the verification queue, or species suggestions?

cases.note: Nothing in the graph is about speed; a question is the only right move.

cases.message: Add an event when a survey is abandoned mid-transect so we can count it.
cases.note: A usage-event already records abandonment as a measurement; the message asks for a system event. Linking the new event to the usage-event or the walk flow is a bonus.

cases.message: The sync service should run on our own servers, not edge functions.
Actually the biologist told me the photo suggestions were wrong on 40% of juvenile crabs, so maybe we hide suggestions for juveniles.

gold.question: The 40% juvenile-crab evidence is already recorded. Should suggestions be hidden for all juveniles, or only for crabs, and should the hypothesis target stay at 80%?

cases.note: The evidence already exists (no duplicate add). 'Maybe' signals a decision; accept either a question or a scoped update to the photo ID feature that says juveniles are excluded.
